# Frozen builder contract

Read the corrected agent-builder and agent-code skills and every bundled reference whole; use the supplied corrected agent-core as an external path dependency. The operator has ratified the requirements and boundaries below. Routine interface field naming and implementation details follow the existing declaration; surface any substantive change before implementing it.

Build one standalone sequential Python requirements-readiness checker, with one real read-only local get_policy(policy_id) tool. Only readiness-v1 exists; policy bytes are in policy.json. Input version 1.0.0, policy_id and brief are required strings with no extra keys; reject empty/oversized brief (16,000 characters) and unknown version/policy before calls. No arbitrary paths or network tools. Invoke as a CLI one input file per call and return one strict JSON envelope; also expose a callable for deterministic fixtures. The returned envelope includes invocation_id, evidence_ref, terminal disposition, and nullable task result. A successful task result has readiness, exact missing requirement ID set, brief-grounded reasons and citations to rule IDs and statement IDs (S1 etc.). Output/return/error schemas and prompt bytes must be explicit versioned files. Failure has no fabricated task judgment. ready requires no missing IDs; needs_clarification requires at least one. Deterministically verify IDs, citations, schema and the declared cross-field invariants; model judgment supplies semantic adequacy.

Use native Anthropic tool_use/tool_result for get_policy, then native structured JSON when supported, parsed whole-only through the core. At least one real policy-tool call is required before successful final judgment. Record actual dispatches, not simulated narration. Core owns parsing, identity stamping, budget mechanism, tool capability/correlation/security and evidence construction. Thin adapters own provider requests, prospective reservations and explicit evidence mapping. Do not duplicate core mechanisms. JSONL local evidence is ratified; PostgreSQL and orchestrators remain unverified.

Provider: direct Messages API, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001; temperature 0, thinking disabled, no streaming, cache, fallback, provider-managed tools, automatic retry or concurrency. SDK max_retries=0. Use existing Anthropic SDK 1.8.0 and jsonschema 4.25.1 runtime as a starting qualified binding; record exact closure. Tests may use existing pytest 9.1.1 runtime separately. No live calls, token-count API calls, credential access, remote network calls or secret discovery by the builder. Build offline. Root and Tad own live launch.

Limits: 2 development smoke inputs here then 6 evaluator inputs held elsewhere, one draw each; total8invocations, no repair/retest budget. Per invocation maximum3physical model attempts,2actual read-only tool dispatches,1024outputtokens/call,60seconds. Preflight provider count rejects >8000inputtokens (count only after Tad's live go). Campaign ceilings500000combinedtokens,$1.00,24modelcalls,16tools,15minutes; whole build/evaluate90minutes. Concurrency1. Unknown usage stops campaign and retains reservation with explicit unknown marker. Reserve 200000inputtokens +1024outputtokens and $0.20512 before each physical model dispatch; reconcile actual usage using input$1/million,output$5/million. This conservatively covers the documented context bound; no estimate-only admission. If the remaining campaign allowance cannot cover the reserve, refuse dispatch. Per-attempt timeout/cancellation must honor remaining invocation and campaign deadline. Campaign state must survive separate interactive invocations and count all failed attempts; never reset it to purchase a pass. Stop at the first failed live case. Human pauses do not silently extend elapsed limits. Root will handle any timing amendment with Tad.

Synthetic prompt/request/response/tool content capture is authorized in this folder only; no authorization headers, credentials, hidden reasoning, account content or raw SDK error bodies. Execution metadata must remain truthful on all paths. Record exact ordered requests, hashes and stop/usage states. Fail closed on unknown stop reasons/blocks, refusal, truncation, malformed output, unknown usage or persistence failure. Native provider faults are simulated in deterministic tests and must be labelled as such. A narrowly scoped empty final text refusal is not success.

Deterministic controls: invalid input before calls; tool dispatch/correlation including wrong/duplicate/orphan/unknown; trusted identity stamping; whole parse/whitespace/malformed/ambiguous/diagnostics; all attempt/tool/token/spend/deadline ceilings and prospective bounds; one physical attempt per accounting event; refusal/truncation/unknown status; unknown usage; cancellation; evidence on every terminal path; denied synthetic write capability; JSONL readback; actual corrected-core import identity. Include known-good and contrary controls. Bound testing to these contract behaviors, not a general platform. Do not execute live smokes. Provide exact commands, requirements, dependency lock/identity, fleet interface, evidence mapping, limitations, and build-use trace including instructions read and any interventions. Stop with an offline handoff ready for root review.

Two public smoke examples are in development-cases.json. The evaluator froze six separate texts and expectations before builder dispatch; do not read trial-evaluator, prior reviews, original review findings or unrelated workspaces. This is logical separation on one host, not hardened secrecy. Preserve all first observations. Do not modify corrected-candidate. Output only in trial-agent.
